QuickJS-ng 0.17.0 (MIT, see LICENSE), from the `upstream-quickjs` folder of the
`quickjs-ng` 0.17.0.1 source package on PyPI. Used to run YouTube's player
challenge solver on the TV (src/youtube.c).

The package leaves out three generated bytecode headers (Array.fromAsync,
Iterator.zip, Iterator.zipKeyed); `builtin-*.h` here are stubs, so those three
builtins throw. Built with `__STDC_NO_ATOMICS__` (no SharedArrayBuffer atomics).
